operation.summary: Open the camera ahead of a photo, so your next snapshot fires in about 0.3 s

body.name: camera
body.description: rear (default) or front: the camera your next snapshot will use

body.name: seconds
body.description: How long to keep it ready, 1-10 (default 10). It closes after your next snapshot, at the end of this time, or when the owner pauses Bridgit

operation.returns: camera, armed, seconds, armed_until, settle_ms (exposure needs this long after the camera opens; a snapshot sent sooner waits out the rest); the next snapshot says warm: true
